payload.tension: The passage states wives, husbands, children, parents, slaves, and masters are addressed. Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord. But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
